acceptedAnswer.text: Hometelligent Inc. manages custom range hood installations, including those that require cabinet modification, by first conducting a detailed assessment to understand the scope. A practical tradeoff for custom work is that it generally takes more time and may incur additional costs compared to a standard replacement, due to the specialized carpentry or structural adjustments needed to achieve the desired fit and finish.
